<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script><![CDATA[api.controller = function($window,$document,$timeout) {
    var c = this;

    c.selectedRecord = null;

    c.requestDropdownOpen = false;
    c.loadingRequestSuggestions = false;
    c.activeSuggestionIndex = -1;

    c.requestNumberSuggestions =
        angular.copy(
            c.data.requestNumberSuggestions || []
        );

    c.filteredRequestNumberSuggestions =
        angular.copy(
            c.requestNumberSuggestions
        );

    c.data.filters =
        c.data.filters || {
            requestNumber: "",
            courseType: "",
            courseFormat: "",
            country: ""
        };

    c.data.selectedStatus =
        c.data.selectedStatus || "manager";

    c.data.stageCounts =
        c.data.stageCounts || {
            manager: 0,
            pending_l2_approval: 0,
            pending_hr_review: 0
        };

    c.data.sortOrder =
        c.data.sortOrder || "asc";

    c.data.loading = false;
    c.data.downloading = false;

    c.clearMessages = function() {
        c.data.successMessage = "";
        c.data.errorMessage = "";
    };

    c.getSelectedApprovalLabel = function() {

        if (
            c.data.selectedStatus ==
            "pending_l2_approval"
        ) {
            return "Management L2";
        }

        if (
            c.data.selectedStatus ==
            "pending_hr_review"
        ) {
            return "HR Learning";
        }

        return "In-Company Manager";
    };

    c.getSelectedStatusLabel = function() {

        if (
            c.data.selectedStatus ==
            "pending_l2_approval"
        ) {
            return "Pending L2 Approval";
        }

        if (
            c.data.selectedStatus ==
            "pending_hr_review"
        ) {
            return "Pending HR Review";
        }

        return "Submitted / Pending Manager Approval";
    };

    c.getCommentsHeading = function() {

        if (
            c.data.selectedStatus ==
            "pending_l2_approval"
        ) {
            return "Management L2 Comments";
        }

        if (
            c.data.selectedStatus ==
            "pending_hr_review"
        ) {
            return "HR Learning Comments";
        }

        return "In-Company Manager Comments";
    };

    c.getRequestParameters = function(action) {

        return {
            action: action,

            selectedStatus:
                c.data.selectedStatus ||
                "manager",

            requestNumber:
                c.data.filters.requestNumber ||
                "",

            courseType:
                c.data.filters.courseType ||
                "",

            courseFormat:
                c.data.filters.courseFormat ||
                "",

            country:
                c.data.filters.country ||
                "",

            sortOrder:
                c.data.sortOrder ||
                "asc"
        };
    };

    c.updateResponse = function(response) {

        var result =
            response.data || {};

        c.data.records =
            result.records || [];

        c.data.countries =
            result.countries || [];

        c.data.courseTypes =
            result.courseTypes || [];

        c.data.courseFormats =
            result.courseFormats || [];

        c.data.stageCounts =
            result.stageCounts || {
                manager: 0,
                pending_l2_approval: 0,
                pending_hr_review: 0
            };

        c.data.successMessage =
            result.successMessage || "";

        c.data.errorMessage =
            result.errorMessage || "";

        if (result.filters) {
            c.data.filters =
                result.filters;
        }

        if (result.selectedStatus) {
            c.data.selectedStatus =
                result.selectedStatus;
        }

        if (result.sortOrder) {
            c.data.sortOrder =
                result.sortOrder;
        }

        c.requestNumberSuggestions =
            angular.copy(
                result.requestNumberSuggestions || []
            );

        c.filterRequestNumberSuggestions();

        c.requestDropdownOpen = false;
        c.activeSuggestionIndex = -1;
        c.selectedRecord = null;
    };

    /*
     * TYPEAHEAD METHODS
     */

    c.onRequestNumberChange = function() {

        c.filterRequestNumberSuggestions();

        c.requestDropdownOpen = true;
        c.activeSuggestionIndex = -1;
    };

    c.filterRequestNumberSuggestions = function() {

        var searchText =
            String(
                c.data.filters.requestNumber || ""
            ).toLowerCase();

        if (!searchText) {

            c.filteredRequestNumberSuggestions =
                angular.copy(
                    c.requestNumberSuggestions
                );

            return;
        }

        c.filteredRequestNumberSuggestions =
            c.requestNumberSuggestions.filter(
                function(suggestion) {

                    var number =
                        String(
                            suggestion.label || ""
                        ).toLowerCase();

                    var courseTitle =
                        String(
                            suggestion.courseTitle || ""
                        ).toLowerCase();

                    var employeeName =
                        String(
                            suggestion.employeeName || ""
                        ).toLowerCase();

                    return (
                        number.indexOf(searchText) > -1 ||
                        courseTitle.indexOf(searchText) > -1 ||
                        employeeName.indexOf(searchText) > -1
                    );
                }
            );
    };

    c.openRequestNumberSuggestions = function() {

        c.filterRequestNumberSuggestions();
        c.requestDropdownOpen = true;
        c.activeSuggestionIndex = -1;
    };

    c.toggleRequestNumberSuggestions = function(event) {

        if (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
        }

        c.requestDropdownOpen =
            !c.requestDropdownOpen;

        if (c.requestDropdownOpen) {
            c.filterRequestNumberSuggestions();
            c.activeSuggestionIndex = -1;
        }
    };

    c.selectRequestNumber = function(
        suggestion,
        event
    ) {

        if (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
        }

        if (!suggestion) {
            return;
        }

        c.data.filters.requestNumber =
            suggestion.value || suggestion.label || "";

        c.requestDropdownOpen = false;
        c.activeSuggestionIndex = -1;

        /*
         * Automatically search after selecting
         * a request number.
         */
        c.search();
    };

    c.clearRequestNumber = function(event) {

        if (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();
        }

        c.data.filters.requestNumber = "";
        c.activeSuggestionIndex = -1;

        c.filterRequestNumberSuggestions();
        c.requestDropdownOpen = true;
    };

    c.handleRequestNumberKeydown = function(event) {

        if (!event) {
            return;
        }

        var keyCode =
            event.which || event.keyCode;

        /*
         * Down arrow.
         */
        if (keyCode == 40) {

            event.preventDefault();

            if (!c.requestDropdownOpen) {
                c.openRequestNumberSuggestions();
            }

            if (
                c.filteredRequestNumberSuggestions.length
            ) {
                c.activeSuggestionIndex++;

                if (
                    c.activeSuggestionIndex >=
                    c.filteredRequestNumberSuggestions.length
                ) {
                    c.activeSuggestionIndex = 0;
                }
            }

            return;
        }

        /*
         * Up arrow.
         */
        if (keyCode == 38) {

            event.preventDefault();

            if (!c.requestDropdownOpen) {
                c.openRequestNumberSuggestions();
            }

            if (
                c.filteredRequestNumberSuggestions.length
            ) {
                c.activeSuggestionIndex--;

                if (
                    c.activeSuggestionIndex < 0
                ) {
                    c.activeSuggestionIndex =
                        c.filteredRequestNumberSuggestions.length - 1;
                }
            }

            return;
        }

        /*
         * Enter.
         */
        if (keyCode == 13) {

            event.preventDefault();

            if (
                c.requestDropdownOpen &&
                c.activeSuggestionIndex >= 0 &&
                c.filteredRequestNumberSuggestions[
                    c.activeSuggestionIndex
                ]
            ) {
                c.selectRequestNumber(
                    c.filteredRequestNumberSuggestions[
                        c.activeSuggestionIndex
                    ],
                    event
                );
            } else {
                c.requestDropdownOpen = false;
                c.search();
            }

            return;
        }

        /*
         * Escape.
         */
        if (keyCode == 27) {

            event.preventDefault();

            c.requestDropdownOpen = false;
            c.activeSuggestionIndex = -1;
        }
    };

    c.handleOutsideClick = function() {
        c.requestDropdownOpen = false;
        c.activeSuggestionIndex = -1;
    };

    /*
     * TAB / FILTER METHODS
     */

    c.selectStatus = function(status) {

        if (c.data.loading) {
            return;
        }

        c.clearMessages();

        c.selectedRecord = null;
        c.requestDropdownOpen = false;

        c.data.selectedStatus = status;

        /*
         * Clear request number because request-number
         * suggestions are different for every tab.
         */
        c.data.filters.requestNumber = "";

        c.search();
    };

    c.selectRecord = function(record) {

        if (!record) {
            return;
        }

        c.selectedRecord = record;

        c.selectedRecord.commentValidationError =
            false;
    };

    c.clearSelectedRecord = function() {
        c.selectedRecord = null;
    };

    c.search = function() {

        if (c.data.loading) {
            return;
        }

        c.clearMessages();

        c.selectedRecord = null;
        c.requestDropdownOpen = false;
        c.data.loading = true;

        c.server.get(
            c.getRequestParameters("search")
        ).then(
            function(response) {

                c.updateResponse(response);
                c.data.loading = false;

            },
            function() {

                c.data.loading = false;

                c.data.errorMessage =
                    "Unable to load learning approvals.";
            }
        );
    };

    c.resetFilters = function() {

        if (c.data.loading) {
            return;
        }

        c.data.filters = {
            requestNumber: "",
            courseType: "",
            courseFormat: "",
            country: ""
        };

        c.data.sortOrder = "asc";
        c.requestDropdownOpen = false;

        c.search();
    };

    c.refresh = function() {

        if (!c.data.loading) {
            c.search();
        }
    };

    c.sortRecords = function() {

        if (c.data.loading) {
            return;
        }

        c.data.sortOrder =
            c.data.sortOrder == "asc"
                ? "desc"
                : "asc";

        c.search();
    };

    /*
     * APPROVE
     */

    c.approve = function(record) {

        if (
            !record ||
            record.processing
        ) {
            return;
        }

        c.clearMessages();

        var comments =
            trimValue(
                record.actionComments
            );

        if (!comments) {

            record.commentValidationError =
                true;

            return;
        }

        record.processing = true;

        record.commentValidationError =
            false;

        var parameters =
            c.getRequestParameters(
                "approve"
            );

        parameters.approval_sys_id =
            record.approval_sys_id;

        parameters.actionComments =
            comments;

        c.server.get(parameters).then(
            function(response) {

                var result =
                    response.data || {};

                if (result.errorMessage) {

                    record.processing = false;

                    c.data.errorMessage =
                        result.errorMessage;

                    return;
                }

                c.updateResponse(response);

            },
            function() {

                record.processing = false;

                c.data.errorMessage =
                    "Unable to approve the learning application.";
            }
        );
    };

    /*
     * REJECT
     */

    c.reject = function(record) {

        if (
            !record ||
            record.processing
        ) {
            return;
        }

        c.clearMessages();

        var comments =
            trimValue(
                record.actionComments
            );

        if (!comments) {

            record.commentValidationError =
                true;

            return;
        }

        record.processing = true;

        record.commentValidationError =
            false;

        var parameters =
            c.getRequestParameters(
                "reject"
            );

        parameters.approval_sys_id =
            record.approval_sys_id;

        parameters.actionComments =
            comments;

        c.server.get(parameters).then(
            function(response) {

                var result =
                    response.data || {};

                if (result.errorMessage) {

                    record.processing = false;

                    c.data.errorMessage =
                        result.errorMessage;

                    return;
                }

                c.updateResponse(response);

            },
            function() {

                record.processing = false;

                c.data.errorMessage =
                    "Unable to reject the learning application.";
            }
        );
    };

    /*
     * REPORT DOWNLOAD
     */

    c.downloadReport = function() {

        if (
            c.data.downloading ||
            c.data.loading
        ) {
            return;
        }

        c.clearMessages();

        c.data.downloading = true;

        c.server.get({
            action: "download_report"
        }).then(
            function(response) {

                var result =
                    response.data || {};

                c.data.downloading = false;

                c.data.successMessage =
                    result.successMessage || "";

                c.data.errorMessage =
                    result.errorMessage || "";

                if (
                    !result.downloadReady ||
                    !result.fileContent
                ) {
                    if (!c.data.errorMessage) {
                        c.data.errorMessage =
                            "The report could not be generated.";
                    }

                    return;
                }

                createDownload(
                    result.fileContent,
                    result.fileName ||
                    "ASEAN_Learning_Approval_Report.csv"
                );

            },
            function() {

                c.data.downloading = false;

                c.data.errorMessage =
                    "Unable to generate the approval report.";
            }
        );
    };

    function createDownload(
        csvContent,
        fileName
    ) {

        try {

            var blob =
                new $window.Blob(
                    ["\uFEFF" + csvContent],
                    {
                        type:
                            "text/csv;charset=utf-8"
                    }
                );

            var urlApi =
                $window.URL ||
                $window.webkitURL;

            var objectUrl =
                urlApi.createObjectURL(blob);

            var link =
                $document[0].createElement("a");

            link.href = objectUrl;
            link.download = fileName;
            link.style.display = "none";

            $document[0].body.appendChild(link);

            link.click();

            $timeout(function() {

                if (link.parentNode) {
                    link.parentNode.removeChild(link);
                }

                urlApi.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);

            }, 1000);

        } catch (error) {

            c.data.errorMessage =
                "The browser could not download the report.";
        }
    }

    function trimValue(value) {

        return String(
            value || ""
        ).replace(
            /^\s+|\s+$/g,
            ""
        );
    }
};]]></client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>.learning-widget {

}]]></link><name>Approval ASEAN</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script><![CDATA[(function() {

    var LEARNING_TABLE =
        "x_1549902_asean_0_learning_application";

    var APPROVAL_TABLE =
        "sysapproval_approver";

    /*
     * Initial widget data.
     */
    data.records = [];
    data.countries = [];
    data.courseTypes = [];
    data.courseFormats = [];
    data.requestNumberSuggestions = [];

    data.stageCounts = {
        manager: 0,
        pending_l2_approval: 0,
        pending_hr_review: 0
    };

    data.successMessage = "";
    data.errorMessage = "";

    data.downloadReady = false;
    data.fileContent = "";
    data.fileName = "";

    /*
     * Read client input.
     */
    var action =
        getInputValue("action");

    var selectedStatus =
        validateSelectedStatus(
            getInputValue("selectedStatus") ||
            "manager"
        );

    var requestNumber =
        getInputValue("requestNumber");

    var courseType =
        getInputValue("courseType");

    var courseFormat =
        getInputValue("courseFormat");

    var country =
        getInputValue("country");

    var sortOrder =
        getInputValue("sortOrder") ||
        "asc";

    if (
        sortOrder != "asc" &&
        sortOrder != "desc"
    ) {
        sortOrder = "asc";
    }

    data.selectedStatus =
        selectedStatus;

    data.sortOrder =
        sortOrder;

    data.filters = {
        requestNumber: requestNumber,
        courseType: courseType,
        courseFormat: courseFormat,
        country: country
    };

    /*
     * Download approved records
     * from the last 90 days.
     */
    if (action == "download_report") {
        generateApprovalReport();
        return;
    }

    /*
     * Approve request.
     */
    if (
        action == "approve" &&
        input &&
        input.approval_sys_id
    ) {
        processApproval(
            String(input.approval_sys_id),
            "approved",
            getInputValue("actionComments")
        );
    }

    /*
     * Reject request.
     */
    if (
        action == "reject" &&
        input &&
        input.approval_sys_id
    ) {
        processApproval(
            String(input.approval_sys_id),
            "rejected",
            getInputValue("actionComments")
        );
    }

    /*
     * Reload widget information.
     */
    loadStageCounts();
    loadFilterChoices();
    loadRequestNumberSuggestions();
    loadPendingApprovals();


    function getInputValue(name) {

        if (
            !input ||
            input[name] === undefined ||
            input[name] === null
        ) {
            return "";
        }

        return String(input[name]);
    }


    function validateSelectedStatus(status) {

        if (
            status == "manager" ||
            status == "pending_l2_approval" ||
            status == "pending_hr_review"
        ) {
            return status;
        }

        return "manager";
    }


    function isStatusForSelectedStage(status) {

        if (selectedStatus == "manager") {

            return (
                status == "submitted" ||
                status ==
                    "pending_manager_approval"
            );
        }

        return status == selectedStatus;
    }


    function getApprovalStageLabel(status) {

        if (
            status ==
            "pending_l2_approval"
        ) {
            return "Management L2";
        }

        if (
            status ==
            "pending_hr_review"
        ) {
            return "HR Learning";
        }

        return "In-Company Manager";
    }


    function loadStageCounts() {

        var approvalGR =
            new GlideRecord(
                APPROVAL_TABLE
            );

        approvalGR.addQuery(
            "approver",
            gs.getUserID()
        );

        approvalGR.addQuery(
            "state",
            "requested"
        );

        approvalGR.query();

        while (approvalGR.next()) {

            var learningGR =
                getLearningRecord(
                    approvalGR
                );

            if (!learningGR) {
                continue;
            }

            var status =
                getValueSafely(
                    learningGR,
                    "u_status"
                );

            if (
                status == "submitted" ||
                status ==
                    "pending_manager_approval"
            ) {
                data.stageCounts.manager++;

            } else if (
                status ==
                "pending_l2_approval"
            ) {
                data.stageCounts
                    .pending_l2_approval++;

            } else if (
                status ==
                "pending_hr_review"
            ) {
                data.stageCounts
                    .pending_hr_review++;
            }
        }
    }


    /*
     * Load request number suggestions.
     */
    function loadRequestNumberSuggestions() {

        var suggestions = [];
        var duplicateMap = {};

        var approvalGR =
            new GlideRecord(
                APPROVAL_TABLE
            );

        approvalGR.addQuery(
            "approver",
            gs.getUserID()
        );

        approvalGR.addQuery(
            "state",
            "requested"
        );

        approvalGR.query();

        while (approvalGR.next()) {

            var learningGR =
                getLearningRecord(
                    approvalGR
                );

            if (!learningGR) {
                continue;
            }

            var status =
                getValueSafely(
                    learningGR,
                    "u_status"
                );

            if (
                !isStatusForSelectedStage(
                    status
                )
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            var number =
                getDisplayValueSafely(
                    learningGR,
                    "number"
                );

            if (
                !number ||
                duplicateMap[number]
            ) {
                continue;
            }

            duplicateMap[number] = true;

            suggestions.push({
                value: number,
                label: number,

                courseTitle:
                    getDisplayValueSafely(
                        learningGR,
                        "u_course_title"
                    ),

                employeeName:
                    getDisplayValueSafely(
                        learningGR,
                        "u_employee_name"
                    ),

                sysId:
                    learningGR
                        .getUniqueValue()
            });
        }

        suggestions.sort(
            function(first, second) {

                var firstNumber =
                    String(
                        first.label || ""
                    ).toLowerCase();

                var secondNumber =
                    String(
                        second.label || ""
                    ).toLowerCase();

                if (
                    firstNumber <
                    secondNumber
                ) {
                    return -1;
                }

                if (
                    firstNumber >
                    secondNumber
                ) {
                    return 1;
                }

                return 0;
            }
        );

        data.requestNumberSuggestions =
            suggestions;
    }


    /*
     * Approve or reject an application.
     */
    function processApproval(
        approvalSysId,
        decision,
        actionComments
    ) {

        actionComments =
            trimValue(actionComments);

        if (!actionComments) {

            data.errorMessage =
                "Please enter the comments.";

            return;
        }

        var approvalGR =
            new GlideRecord(
                APPROVAL_TABLE
            );

        approvalGR.addQuery(
            "sys_id",
            approvalSysId
        );

        approvalGR.addQuery(
            "approver",
            gs.getUserID()
        );

        approvalGR.addQuery(
            "state",
            "requested"
        );

        approvalGR.setLimit(1);
        approvalGR.query();

        if (!approvalGR.next()) {

            data.errorMessage =
                "The approval was not found or is no longer pending.";

            return;
        }

        var learningGR =
            getLearningRecord(
                approvalGR
            );

        if (!learningGR) {

            data.errorMessage =
                "The approval is not related to a Learning Application.";

            return;
        }

        var recordStatus =
            getValueSafely(
                learningGR,
                "u_status"
            );

        if (
            !isStatusForSelectedStage(
                recordStatus
            )
        ) {

            data.errorMessage =
                "The application is no longer in the selected approval stage.";

            return;
        }

        /*
         * Save comments in the
         * stage-specific field.
         */
        if (
            selectedStatus ==
            "manager"
        ) {

            if (
                learningGR.isValidField(
                    "u_direct_manager_comments"
                )
            ) {
                learningGR.setValue(
                    "u_direct_manager_comments",
                    actionComments
                );
            }

        } else if (
            selectedStatus ==
            "pending_l2_approval"
        ) {

            if (
                learningGR.isValidField(
                    "u_l2_manager_comments"
                )
            ) {
                learningGR.setValue(
                    "u_l2_manager_comments",
                    actionComments
                );
            }

        } else if (
            selectedStatus ==
            "pending_hr_review"
        ) {

            if (
                learningGR.isValidField(
                    "u_hr_comments"
                )
            ) {
                learningGR.setValue(
                    "u_hr_comments",
                    actionComments
                );
            }
        }

        var actionLabel =
            decision == "approved"
                ? "Approved"
                : "Rejected";

        var journalText =
            actionLabel +
            " by: " +
            gs.getUserDisplayName() +
            "\nApproval Stage: " +
            getApprovalStageLabel(
                selectedStatus
            ) +
            "\nComments: " +
            actionComments;

        /*
         * Write only to Additional comments.
         *
         * Standard technical field name:
         * comments
         */
        if (
            learningGR.isValidField(
                "comments"
            )
        ) {
            learningGR.comments =
                journalText;
        }

        /*
         * Fallback custom field only when
         * the standard comments field
         * does not exist.
         */
        if (
            !learningGR.isValidField(
                "comments"
            ) &&
            learningGR.isValidField(
                "u_comment"
            )
        ) {

            var existingComment =
                learningGR.getValue(
                    "u_comment"
                ) || "";

            learningGR.setValue(
                "u_comment",
                existingComment
                    ? existingComment +
                      "\n\n" +
                      journalText
                    : journalText
            );
        }

        /*
         * Rejected request moves to
         * Rejected status.
         */
        if (
            decision ==
            "rejected"
        ) {
            learningGR.setValue(
                "u_status",
                "rejected"
            );
        }

        learningGR.update();

        /*
         * Save comment on the approval
         * record itself.
         *
         * This does not update the Learning
         * Request work notes.
         */
        if (
            approvalGR.isValidField(
                "comments"
            )
        ) {
            approvalGR.comments =
                actionComments;
        }

        approvalGR.setValue(
            "state",
            decision
        );

        approvalGR.update();

        data.successMessage =
            decision == "approved"
                ? "Learning application approved successfully."
                : "Learning application rejected successfully.";
    }

                    getDisplayValueSafely(

                        "u_hr_comments"

                actionComments: "",

            });

        records.sort(
            function(
                firstRecord,
                secondRecord

                var first =
                    String(

                        ""
                    ).toLowerCase();

                var second =
                    String(
                        secondRecord.number ||
                        ""
                    ).toLowerCase();

                if (first < second) {
                    return sortOrder ==
                        "asc" ? -1 : 1;
                }

                if (first > second) {
                    return sortOrder ==
                        "asc" ? 1 : -1;
                }

                return 0;
            }
        );

        data.records = records;

    function matchesFilters(
        learningGR
    ) {

        var status =
            getValueSafely(
                learningGR,
                "u_status"
            );

        if (
            !isStatusForSelectedStage(
                status
            )
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        if (requestNumber) {

            var number =
                getDisplayValueSafely(
                    learningGR,
                    "number"
                );

            if (
                !containsIgnoreCase(
                    number,
                    requestNumber
                )
            ) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if (
            courseType &&
            getValueSafely(
                learningGR,
                "u_course_type"
            ) != courseType
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        if (
            courseFormat &&
            getValueSafely(
                learningGR,
                "u_course_format"
            ) != courseFormat
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        if (
            country &&
            getValueSafely(
                learningGR,
                "u_country"
            ) != country
        ) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

        data.downloadReady = false;

        data.fileName = "";

        try {

                var learningGR =

                count++;

    function getReportApprovalStage(

                approvalGR

        var descriptionLower =
            String(shortDescription)
                .toLowerCase();

        if (
            descriptionLower
                .indexOf("hr") > -1
        ) {
            return "HR Learning";
        }

        if (
            descriptionLower
                .indexOf("l2") > -1
        ) {
            return "Management L2";
        }

        if (
            descriptionLower
                .indexOf("manager") > -1
        ) {
            return "In-Company Manager";
        }

        var approverSysId =
            approvalGR.getValue(
                "approver"
            );

        var directManager =
            getValueSafely(
                learningGR,
                "u_direct_manager"
            );

        if (
            !directManager &&
            learningGR.isValidField(
                "u_manager_email"
            ) &&
            learningGR
                .getElement(
                    "u_manager_email"
                )
                .getED()
                .getInternalType() ==
                "reference"
        ) {
            directManager =
                getValueSafely(
                    learningGR,
                    "u_manager_email"
                );
        }

        var l2Manager =
            getValueSafely(
                learningGR,
                "u_management_l2"
            );

        if (
            approverSysId &&
            approverSysId ==
                l2Manager
        ) {
            return "Management L2";
        }

        if (
            approverSysId &&
            approverSysId ==
                directManager
        ) {
            return "In-Company Manager";
        }

        return "Approval";
    }

        approvalGR

    ) {

        if (

        map[value] = true;

        collection.push({
            value: value,
            label: label || value
        });

    function sortChoices(

        collection.sort(
            function(

                var first =

                        ""
                    ).toLowerCase();

                var second =
                    String(

                        ""
                    ).toLowerCase();

                if (first < second) {
                    return -1;
                }

                if (first > second) {
                    return 1;
                }

                return 0;
            }
        );
    }


    function containsIgnoreCase(

                ) > -1
        );

    function escapeCsv(value) {

        value =
            String(value || "");

        value =
            value
                .split("\r\n")
                .join(" ");

        value =
            value
                .split("\n")
                .join(" ");

        value =
            value
                .split("\r")
                .join(" ");

        /*
         * Prevent CSV formula injection.
         */
        var firstCharacter =
            value.length
                ? value.charAt(0)
                : "";

        if (
            firstCharacter == "=" ||
            firstCharacter == "+" ||
            firstCharacter == "-" ||
            firstCharacter == "@"
        ) {
            value = "'" + value;
        }

        value =
            value
                .split('"')
                .join('""');

        return '"' + value + '"';
    }


    function createCsvRow(values) {

        var row = [];

        for (
            var index = 0;
            index < values.length;
            index++

                )
            );
        }

                 c.data.selectedStatus == 'pending_l2_approval' ||
                 c.data.selectedStatus == 'pending_hr_review'
               ">

            <div class="detail-section-title">
              Previous Approval Comments
            </div>

            <div class="previous-comment-card">

              <div class="previous-comment-heading">
                <i class="fa fa-user"></i>
                Direct Manager Comments
              </div>

              <div class="previous-comment-text">
                {{
                  c.selectedRecord.direct_manager_comments ||
                  'No comments provided'
                }}
              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="previous-comment-card"
                 ng-if="c.data.selectedStatus == 'pending_hr_review'">

              <div class="previous-comment-heading">
                <i class="fa fa-users"></i>
                L2 Manager Comments
              </div>

              <div class="previous-comment-text">
                {{
                  c.selectedRecord.l2_manager_comments ||
                  'No comments provided'
                }}
              </div>

            </div>

          </div>

          <div class="selected-comments-panel">

            <div class="comments-title">

              {{c.getCommentsHeading()}}

              <span class="mandatory-symbol">*</span>

            </div>

            <textarea class="form-control selected-comments-textarea"
                      rows="5"
                      maxlength="4000"
                      ng-model="c.selectedRecord.actionComments"
                      ng-change="c.selectedRecord.commentValidationError = false"
                      placeholder="Enter comments">
            </textarea>

            <div class="comments-help">
              Comments are mandatory for approval and rejection.
            </div>

            <div class="field-error"
                 ng-if="c.selectedRecord.commentValidationError">

              Please enter the comments.

            </div>

            <div class="selected-record-actions">

              <button type="button"
                      class="decision-btn approve-btn"
                      ng-click="c.approve(c.selectedRecord)"
                      ng-disabled="c.selectedRecord.processing">

                <i class="fa fa-check"
                   ng-if="!c.selectedRecord.processing">
                </i>

                <span ng-if="!c.selectedRecord.processing">
                  Approve
                </span>

                <span ng-if="c.selectedRecord.processing">
                  Processing...
                </span>

              </button>

              <button type="button"
                      class="decision-btn reject-btn"
                      ng-click="c.reject(c.selectedRecord)"
                      ng-disabled="c.selectedRecord.processing">

                <i class="fa fa-times"
                   ng-if="!c.selectedRecord.processing">
                </i>

                <span ng-if="!c.selectedRecord.processing">
                  Reject
                </span>

                <span ng-if="c.selectedRecord.processing">
                  Processing...
                </span>

              </button>

            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

    </div>

  </div>

  <div class="back-section">

    <a href="?id=manager_role_asean"
       class="back-btn"
       title="Back">

      <i class="fa fa-chevron-left"></i>

    </a>

  </div>

</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
